strategy_name: Advanced Trading Psychology Risk Management Framework
setup_conditions: 80% of trading success depends on psychology, 10% on risk-reward, and only 10% on analysis and strategies
90% of trading game is psychology and risk-reward combined
Do not compare your P&L or trading results with anyone else — compare only with yourself (last week vs this week, last month vs this month)
Stop watching Instagram reels and social media overnight success stories — they corrupt your mind as a trader
Meditate or give your mind 5 to 10 minutes of calm before trading session begins
Set a realistic monthly return target of 20% to 50% for advanced/retail traders
Set a fixed monthly capital for trading — do not trade more or less than that capital
Define maximum monthly loss threshold first (think negative before positive)
Divide monthly loss threshold by number of trading days (approx 20-21 days) to get per-day loss capacity
If monthly loss quota is exhausted early (e.g., in 6-7 days), stop trading for the rest of the month
Never trade without a proper plan — entry, SL, target must all be pre-defined
SL must be defined in cash terms (rupees), not just in points
Quantity must be managed to match risk in rupees — do not widen stop loss to accommodate more risk, instead increase quantity keeping SL same
Unused daily loss capacity from days with no trades can be accumulated and used on high probability trade days (e.g., expiry day or Wednesday when momentum is visible)
On expiry day or high momentum days, risk 20-30% of accumulated profits along with base risk
Risk from profits: at least 25-30% of profits should be risked on high probability setups to grow account size
If you break your own rules, you cannot become a trader

conditions: Only enter when a high probability trade is visible (e.g., SMC-based sniper scalp setup on expiry day)
Only increase position size (quantity) on high probability trades when unused loss capacity is available
entry_trigger.indicator_values: SMC (Smart Money Concepts) mentioned as basis for high probability trade identification

stop_loss.description: Trading mein SL ko cash se define karte hain — 5000 rupee risk on 50 point SL means quantity is calculated accordingly. To increase risk to 15000 rupees, keep SL at 50 points but triple the quantity (100 to 300 quantity). Never widen stop loss — always adjust quantity.

targets: Minimum 1.2x risk-reward ratio mentioned as base target
Target scales proportionally with quantity — if quantity is tripled, target reward triples too
Monthly realistic return target: 20% to 50% of capital
exit_rules: If monthly loss quota is fully used up, stop trading for the rest of the month — no exceptions
If daily loss limit is hit, do not take further trades that day
risk_management: Set fixed monthly capital. Divide maximum monthly loss by ~20 trading days to get daily loss capacity. Accumulate unused daily loss capacity for high probability days. Risk 20-30% of profits on high probability setups. Define SL in rupee terms not points. Increase quantity to scale risk, never widen SL. 3-4 months of following rules strictly required for consistent results.
filters: Do not trade if monthly loss quota is already exhausted
Do not increase risk on normal/average probability trades — only on high probability setups
Do not widen stop loss to accommodate larger risk — wrong approach
Do not compare your results with other traders — leads to unrealistic targets and irrational decisions
